A bedtime adventure for River

River and theNightjar

A train that lays its own rails of light stops outside your window. It is going north. Are you coming?

Keyboard, controller or touch. The story is read out loud, so a grown-up and a kid can play together.

The end

Not everything true leaves tracks.

For River, from Dad.

Every chapter is open. Start anywhere you like.
